user.title: DrayTek Vigor
user.description: Enter the address of your DrayTek Vigor. SNMP (v2c) must be enabled on the device (System Maintenance > SNMP).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Vigor, e.g. 192.168.1.1.
data_description.community: Read community configured on the Vigor (default: public).

interface.title: Select WAN interface
interface.description: Choose the interface that carries your DSL/WAN link. On DrayOS 5 (e.g. Vigor167) this is usually ptm0.

dsl.title: DSL line values (optional)
dsl.description: With the web login the integration also reads sync rate, attainable rate, SNR margin, attenuation and error counters (DrayOS 5, e.g. Vigor167). Read-only - nothing is changed on the device. Leave the user empty to skip; you can add it later under Configure.

data_description.web_username: Login of the Vigor's web interface (usually admin). Leave empty to skip the DSL values.
data_description.web_ssl: Only needed if 'Force HTTPS' is enabled on the Vigor (self-signed certificates are accepted).

reauth_confirm.title: Web login rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Vigor rejected the web login several times. Enter the current credentials.

error.cannot_connect: No SNMP answer. Check address, community and that SNMP is enabled.
error.not_draytek: The device answered, but it does not look like a DrayTek.
error.no_interfaces: The device does not report any interfaces via SNMP.
error.web_invalid_auth: Web login rejected. Check user and password (the Vigor also rejects logins when too many web sessions are open).
error.web_cannot_connect: The web interface did not answer as expected. DSL values via the web API need DrayOS 5 (e.g. Vigor167); with 'Force HTTPS' enable the HTTPS option.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

init.title: DrayTek Vigor options
init.description: Leave the web user empty to switch the DSL values off. Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.
